agent_explanation: Pairwise gravity should conserve total momentum exactly since F_ij=-F_ji, but the leapfrog with fixed outer dt=0.007 and only 3 substeps per step under-resolves the close encounter of bodies 1-2 (distance shrinks 1.44 at step 70 to 1.19 at step 74 while light body 2's speed grows 2.88 to 4.92). Stale/asymmetric force evaluations across the substepped update then inject net momentum (px drifts 65.961 at step 0/60 down to 65.879 at step 74) and angular momentum, tripping the 0.1% tolerance. Halving dt with identical steps eliminates the violation, confirming time-resolution error, not a physics or initial-condition issue.
